about: What each of the lady's 57 recordings can play in a Drop Edition, with which of its measured words (lady-phrases.json), and what it is about. Built by hand, checked by scripts/check-casting.mjs. words: [first, last] word indexes; tag: its impact is the next word; sink: split is the first deep word; tracks: where the cut fits the role's limits (casting.js fits()); craft: how well it plays the role, 0-1; heard: what Whisper (small.en) hears in the cut alone, enveloped as the engine plays it; mix (tag and sink): what it hears in two bars of the band on each track, and the share of her words it hears in order.
